name: Buenos Aires
tagline: Grand cafés, tango and walkable barrios
summary: Mix the civic centre with Recoleta, San Telmo and Palermo. Food, architecture and a tango evening are more rewarding than racing between distant landmarks.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are pleasant for walking; summer can be humid and winter evenings cool.
arrival: EZE is the main international airport; AEP is closer to town. Confirm which airport your onward flight uses.
gettingAround: Subte, buses and booked rides link neighbourhoods; walk within each area.
cashTip: Argentina prices and exchange arrangements change quickly; treat peso budgets as provisional and check card/ATM terms.
foodTip: Try empanadas, pizza, grilled vegetables or parrilla dishes; dinner tends to be late.
buyTip: Look for locally made leather, design goods and mate sets; confirm material and provenance.
baseArea: Palermo or Recoleta for a convenient first visit.

connections.note: Approximate air time; verify AEP versus EZE departure.
Approximate air time; weather can affect crossings.

reviewSummary: Official and visitor lists converge on historic neighbourhoods, major architecture and tango. Ratings for tour packages are not used as ratings for the underlying sights.

items.name: Teatro Colón
items.summary: A major opera house with ornate interiors and guided visits.
items.expect: Tours and performances are separate products with different prices.
items.tip: Reserve the preferred language and distinguish a guided visit from a show ticket.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate for a guided visitor tour; peso prices can change quickly.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Ornate public rooms and the auditorium show the city’s opera-house ambition.
A guided visit explains the building, while a performance adds its musical purpose.
visitFlow: Decide between a tour and a performance before booking.
Attend the selected experience, leaving time to appreciate the interior details.
items.bestFor: Opera-house architecture or a planned show
items.tradeoffs: Tours and performances are separate products with different prices.

items.name: Recoleta Cemetery
items.summary: A sculptural city of mausoleums with layers of Argentine history.
items.expect: An extensive outdoor site; shade can be limited.
items.tip: Use an official plan or guide to find key monuments; verify foreign-visitor ticket rules.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult; check the current official price.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Mausoleums make the cemetery a dense outdoor collection of architecture and sculpture.
Individual monuments connect the site with Argentine public history.
visitFlow: Use a site plan or guide to choose a few graves and monuments.
Walk respectfully through the lanes without treating every tomb as a photo prop.
items.tradeoffs: An extensive outdoor site; shade can be limited.

items.name: Plaza de Mayo & Casa Rosada
items.summary: Start with the civic square and surrounding historic buildings.
items.expect: Public events can restrict access; exterior visits are easy to combine.
items.tip: Check current conditions and arrange any interior visits separately.
items.priceNote: Public square free; interior tours subject to separate arrangements.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The civic square concentrates major institutions and public-memory landmarks.
Casa Rosada’s exterior provides a clear visual anchor for the historical centre.
visitFlow: Walk the plaza and identify the main surrounding buildings.
Add a separate interior visit only after checking its access arrangements.
items.tradeoffs: Public events can restrict access; exterior visits are easy to combine.

items.name: Caminito, La Boca
items.summary: Colourful façades and performance culture make a distinctive daytime stop.
items.expect: A busy visitor enclave; surrounding areas vary.
items.tip: Travel directly to and from the established visitor area in daylight.
items.priceNote: Street area free; posed photos and performances may expect payment.

review.note: Included in the researched destination shortlist; no verified numeric rating snapshot. Open current visitor reviews.

whyVisit: Bright façades and outdoor performance create a visually distinctive daytime route.
The pedestrian visitor area gives a compact introduction to La Boca’s public image.
visitFlow: Travel directly to the established visitor area.
Walk the colourful streets and agree any performance-photo charge before participating.
items.tradeoffs: A busy visitor enclave; surrounding areas vary.

items.name: A tango evening in San Telmo
items.summary: Choose a staged show or a social milonga to experience the dance.
items.expect: A show and a community dance night offer very different experiences.
items.tip: Compare dinner inclusions and pickup charges; follow the venue’s etiquette at a milonga.
items.priceNote: Wide planning estimate for milonga/show options; dining packages cost more.

review.note: Included in the researched destination shortlist; no verified numeric rating snapshot. Open current visitor reviews.

whyVisit: Tango combines live music, movement and a strong local cultural tradition.
A staged show and a social milonga offer two genuinely different ways to participate.
visitFlow: Choose a show or social dance night according to your interests.
Check inclusions, then follow the venue’s viewing or dancing etiquette.
items.tradeoffs: A show and a community dance night offer very different experiences.

items.summary: A focused museum visit for Latin American modern and contemporary art.
items.expect: An indoor art museum with changing displays.
items.tip: Check the official page before setting out.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The collection gives regional art a dedicated place in the trip.
Temporary exhibitions and a free digital guide add routes through the galleries.
visitFlow: Check which collection and temporary exhibitions are open.
Use the digital guide for a small selection of works instead of rushing all galleries.
items.tradeoffs: Nominal Argentine prices change; confirm current tickets and closure day.

items.name: El Ateneo Grand Splendid
items.summary: Browse a bookshop inside a preserved former theatre.
items.expect: A commercial bookshop; keep walkways clear and respect readers.
items.tip: Check the official page before setting out.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The former auditorium retains balconies, painted dome and theatrical decoration.
It is a working bookshop, so the architectural visit can also lead to a meaningful book purchase.
visitFlow: Pause inside the entrance to take in the auditorium.
Browse the shelves and upper levels where access is open.
items.tradeoffs: It can be busy and most books are in Spanish.

dayClusters.label: The civic centre and Teatro Colon
dayClusters.note: Walk the civic centre and reserve a suitable theatre-tour time. Allow time between neighbourhood blocks and distinguish the tour ticket from a performance ticket.

dayClusters.label: San Telmo food, craft and tango
dayClusters.note: Spend the daytime around the market and shops, take a long break, then attend a prebooked evening show or milonga. Sunday is busiest for street antiques; this is a long-span day with downtime, not nonstop walking.

dayClusters.label: A relaxed Recoleta day
dayClusters.note: Make the cemetery the anchor for a leisurely neighbourhood day. Only the researched visit is scheduled; leave the remaining time for lunch, rest or your own interests.

dayClusters.label: Daylight La Boca visit
dayClusters.note: Use a direct booked ride to and from the established visitor area in daylight. This is intentionally a short outing, leaving flexibility for a flight, weather or another reserved activity.
